description: A header with EOT 0 carries no end time and does not shorten the estimate from another header.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED (A-0041, A-0047); its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0 to SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3, U_PDU "hello", no confirmation) is data queued for transmission and produces no SIS output (A-0095, K-0096). Every received D_PDU is a single-segment NON-ARQ-DATA (type 7, address size 4, C_PDU ID as stated, reception window 20) whose segment is a DATA C_PDU holding a DATA S_PDU from SAP 9 to SAP 9 with U_PDU "hi". From 0.0.1.3 to 0.0.1.9: at 2000 a D_PDU with EOT 0 (C_PDU ID 1), which gives no end time (C-0105); at 3000 one with EOT 10 (C_PDU ID 2), end 8000. Had EOT 0 been read as an end time of 2000 the estimate would be 2000 and DCD would clear last. The prediction is 8000, so at the burst end (4000) csma.vdcd_end runs 4000 ms, then rule 3 gives 3000 ms.
